# Metrics reference

Prama's own operational metrics, exported at `GET /metrics` in the Prometheus
text format. Labels name kinds (a verdict, an assertion kind, a route
template, a purpose), never a control, a dataset or a tenant, so the number
of series does not grow with the estate. Each metric caps its series at
200; past it, new label values fold into `other`, counted by
`prama_metric_series_folded_total`.

These measure Prama. None of them is ever an input to a data quality score.

See [observability.md](observability.md) for the endpoints, tracing and
OpenLineage, and the Helm values.

| Metric | Type | Labels | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prama_build_info` | gauge | `version` | The running build; always 1. |
| `prama_control_duration_seconds` | histogram | `kind` | Time from compiling a control to recording it. |
| `prama_control_runs_total` | counter | `trigger` | Control runs started. |
| `prama_control_verdicts_total` | counter | `verdict`, `kind` | Verdicts recorded, by verdict and assertion kind. |
| `prama_delegate_runs_total` | counter | `outcome` | Delegate measurements, by outcome. |
| `prama_evidence_anchors_total` | counter | `status` | Attempts to anchor the chain head, by outcome. |
| `prama_evidence_records_total` | counter | — | Evidence records appended. |
| `prama_http_request_duration_seconds` | histogram | `route` | HTTP request latency, by route template. |
| `prama_http_requests_total` | counter | `method`, `route`, `status` | HTTP requests, by method, route template and status class. |
| `prama_llm_calls_total` | counter | `purpose`, `outcome` | Model calls through the gateway, by purpose and outcome. |
| `prama_llm_cost_micros_total` | counter | `purpose` | Model spend in millionths of the ledger's currency. |
| `prama_openlineage_events_total` | counter | `outcome` | OpenLineage events, by outcome. |
| `prama_run_duration_seconds` | histogram | `trigger` | Time for a whole run over one source. |
| `prama_scheduler_ticks_total` | counter | `outcome` | Scheduler ticks, by outcome. |
| `prama_metric_series_folded_total` | counter | — | Observations folded into `other` because a metric reached its series cap. |
